ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's knowledge of human actions in Surah Al-Inshiqaq?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Inshiqaq, this verse underscores the inevitability of the Day of Judgment, where every individual will be held accountable for their specific deeds. Shia exegesis highlights this as a precursor to the detailed accounting (Hisab) and the weighing of actions (Mizan), reinforcing the justice of God who records even the slightest intention and action.
